an abstract domain: a Java class the engine calls to analyze programs.

whose opening line is three backticks, then `java`, then the file's path:

```java src/pag/domains/gen/<YourDomain>.java
package pag.domains.gen;
...
```

directories under them match the package. Anything outside those blocks is
ignored, so explain in comments if you need to explain.

Pseudo:
```
static LinearForm fromRVal(RVal v) {
  BigInteger c = evalConst(v);
  if (c != null) return of(empty, Fraction.of(c));
  switch (v) {
    case RVal.IntConst ic -> ... // not needed
    case LVal.Local l -> { map put varName(l), ONE; return of(map, ZERO); }
    case LVal.StaticField sf -> { BigInteger k=knownStatic(sf); if k!=null return const; else map put staticName(sf), ONE; }
    case RVal.Binop b -> {
       BinOp op = b.op();
       if (op == BinOp.Mult) {
          BigInteger lc = evalConst(b.l()); BigInteger rc = evalConst(b.r());
          if (lc != null) { if (lc.signum()==0) return zero; LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r()); if (rf != null) return rf.scale(Fraction.of(lc)); return null; }
          if (rc != null) { if (rc.signum()==0) return zero; LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l()); if (lf != null) return lf.scale(Fraction.of(rc)); return null; }
          LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l()); LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
          if (lf == null || rf == null) return null;
          if (lf.isZero() || rf.isZero()) return zero;
          if (lf.isConstant()) return rf.scale(lf.const());
          if (rf.isConstant()) return lf.scale(rf.const());
          return null;
       } else if (op == BinOp.Add || op == BinOp.Sub) {
          LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l()); LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
          if (lf == null || rf == null) return null;
          return op == Add ? lf.add(rf) : lf.subtract(rf);
       } else {
          // comparison: not linear unless constant (handled)
          return null;
       }
    }
  }
}
```

private static final class Fraction implements Comparable<Fraction> {
  static final Fraction ZERO = new Fraction(BigInteger.ZERO, BigInteger.ONE);
  static final Fraction ONE = new Fraction(BigInteger.ONE, BigInteger.ONE);
  final BigInteger num;

  private Fraction(BigInteger num, BigInteger den) {

    if (num.signum() == 0) { this.num = BigInteger.ZERO; this.den = BigInteger.ONE; }
    else {
      BigInteger n = num, d = den;

      BigInteger g = n.abs().gcd(d);
      if (!g.equals(BigInteger.ONE)) { n = n.divide(g); d = d.divide(g); }
      this.num = n; this.den = d;
    }
  }
  static Fraction of(BigInteger n) { return new Fraction(n, BigInteger.ONE); }
  static Fraction of(long n) { return of(BigInteger.valueOf(n)); }

}

private static String chooseVar(List<Constraint> cons) {
  Map<String, int[]> counts = new HashMap<>();
  for (Constraint c : cons) for (Map.Entry<String,Fraction> e : c.coeffs.entrySet()) {
    int[] cn = counts.computeIfAbsent(e.getKey(), k -> new int[2]);
    if (e.getValue().isPositive()) cn[0]++; else if (e.getValue().isNegative()) cn[1]++;
  }
  String one = null; int maxCount=0;
  String both = null; int minPairs=Integer.MAX_VALUE;
  for (Map.Entry<String,int[]> e : counts.entrySet()) {
    int pos=e.getValue()[0], neg=e.getValue()[1];
    if (pos>0 && neg>0) { int pairs=pos*neg; if (pairs<minPairs) {minPairs=pairs; both=e.getKey();}}
    else if (pos>0 || neg>0) { int cnt=pos+neg; if (cnt>maxCount) {maxCount=cnt; one=e.getKey();}}
  }
  if (one != null) return one;
  return both;
}
```

private static List<Constraint> eliminateVar(List<Constraint> cons, String x, NodeCounter nc) {
  List<Constraint> without = new ArrayList<>(); List<Constraint> pos = new ArrayList<>(); List<Constraint> neg = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Constraint c : cons) {
    Fraction cx = c.coeff(x);
    if (cx == null || cx.isZero()) without.add(c);
    else if (cx.isPositive()) pos.add(c);
    else neg.add(c);
  }
  if (pos.isEmpty() || neg.isEmpty()) return normalize(without);
  if (!nc.decrement()) return null;
  if ((long)pos.size() * (long)neg.size() + without.size() > MAX_CONSTRAINTS) return null;
  List<Constraint> derived = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Constraint p : pos) {
    Fraction a = p.coeff(x);
    for (Constraint n : neg) {
      Fraction c = n.coeff(x);
      Constraint pScaled = p.scale(c.negate());
      Constraint nScaled = n.scale(a);
      Constraint d = pScaled.add(nScaled);
      if (d.isFalse()) return List.of(Constraint.FALSE);
      if (!d.isTrue()) derived.add(d);
    }
  }
  List<Constraint> result = new ArrayList<>(without);
  result.addAll(derived);
  return normalize(result);
}
```

  if (!nc.decrement()) return true;

private boolean entailsPolyDisj(Poly p, List<Poly> qs) {
  if (qs.isEmpty()) return !feasible(p.constraints);
  for (Poly q : qs) if (q.isEmpty()) return true;

private boolean outsideFeasible(Poly p, List<Poly> qs, int idx, List<Constraint> current, NodeCounter nc) {
  if (!nc.decrement()) return true;
  List<Constraint> norm = normalize(current);
  if (norm == null) return true;
  if (norm.size()==1 && norm.get(0).isFalse()) return false;
  if (idx == qs.size()) return feasibleRec(norm, nc);
  Poly q = qs.get(idx);
  for (Constraint c : q.constraints) {
    List<Constraint> next = new ArrayList<>(norm);
    next.add(c.negate());
    List<Constraint> normNext = normalize(next);
    if (normNext == null) return true;
    if (normNext.size()==1 && normNext.get(0).isFalse()) continue;
    if (outsideFeasible(p, qs, idx+1, normNext, nc)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

static LinearForm fromRVal(RVal v) {
  BigInteger c = evalConst(v);
  if (c != null) return of(new TreeMap<>(), Fraction.of(c));
  switch (v) {
    case RVal.IntConst ic -> { return of(new TreeMap<>(), Fraction.of(ic.v())); }
    case LVal.Local l -> { Map<String,Fraction> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put(localName(l), Fraction.ONE); return of(m, Fraction.ZERO); }
    case LVal.StaticField sf -> { BigInteger k = knownStatic(sf); if (k != null) return of(new TreeMap<>(), Fraction.of(k)); Map<String,Fraction> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put(staticName(sf), Fraction.ONE); return of(m, Fraction.ZERO); }
    case RVal.Binop b -> {
      BinOp op = b.op();
      if (op == BinOp.Mult) {
        BigInteger lc = evalConst(b.l());
        BigInteger rc = evalConst(b.r());
        if (lc != null) {
          if (lc.signum() == 0) return zero();
          LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
          if (rf == null) return null;
          return rf.scale(Fraction.of(lc));
        }
        if (rc != null) {
          if (rc.signum() == 0) return zero();
          LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l());
          if (lf == null) return null;
          return lf.scale(Fraction.of(rc));
        }
        LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l());
        LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
        if (lf == null || rf == null) return null;
        if (lf.isZero() || rf.isZero()) return zero();
        if (lf.isConstant()) return rf.scale(lf.bound());
        if (rf.isConstant()) return lf.scale(rf.bound());
        return null;
      } else if (op == BinOp.Add || op == BinOp.Sub) {
        LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l());
        LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
        if (lf == null || rf == null) return null;
        return op == BinOp.Add ? lf.add(rf) : lf.subtract(rf);
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

private static BigInteger evalConst(RVal v) {
  switch (v) {
    case RVal.IntConst ic -> { return ic.v(); }
    case LVal.Local l -> { return null; }
    case LVal.StaticField sf -> { return knownStatic(sf); }
    case RVal.Binop b -> {

      BigInteger r = evalConst(b.r());
      if (l == null || r == null) return null;
      return switch (b.op()) {
        case Mult -> l.multiply(r);
        case Add -> l.add(r);
        case Sub -> l.subtract(r);
        case Lt -> l.compareTo(r) < 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Le -> l.compareTo(r) <= 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Gt -> l.compareTo(r) > 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Ge -> l.compareTo(r) >= 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Eq -> l.equals(r) ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Ne -> l.equals(r) ? BigInteger.ZERO : BigInteger.ONE;
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

private static Tri constraintNonLinearTri(Constraint c, String x, RVal src, Evaluator ev) {
  Fraction cx = c.coeff(x);
  Interval total = Interval.ZERO;
  for (Map.Entry<String,Fraction> e : c.coeffs().entrySet()) {

  total = total.add(eInt.scale(cx));
  if (total.isBottom()) return Tri.UNKNOWN;
  Fraction bound = c.bound();
  if (c.op() == Constraint.Op.LE) {
    if (total.high != null && total.high.compareTo(bound) <= 0) return Tri.TRUE;
    if (total.low != null && total.low.compareTo(bound) > 0) return Tri.FALSE;

    if (total.low != null && total.low.compareTo(bound) >= 0) return Tri.FALSE;

        case Ge -> { return addConstraint(p, diff.negate(), Constraint.Op.LE, Fraction.ZERO); }
        case Eq -> { return addConstraints(p, diff, Constraint.Op.LE, Fraction.ZERO, diff.negate(), Constraint.Op.LE, Fraction.ZERO); }
        case Ne -> {

static LinearForm fromRVal(RVal v) {
  BigInteger c = evalConst(v);

  switch (v) {

    case RVal.Binop b -> {

          if (lc != null) { if (lc.signum()==0) return zero; LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r()); if (rf != null) return rf.scale(Fraction.of(lc)); return null; }
          if (rc != null) { if (rc.signum()==0) return zero; LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l()); if (lf != null) return lf.scale(Fraction.of(rc)); return null; }
          LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l()); LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
          if (lf == null || rf == null) return null;
          if (lf.isZero() || rf.isZero()) return zero;
          if (lf.isConstant()) return rf.scale(lf.const());
          if (rf.isConstant()) return lf.scale(rf.const());

          return op == Add ? lf.add(rf) : lf.subtract(rf);
       } else {
          // comparison: not linear unless constant (handled)
          return null;
       }
    }
  }
}

  final BigInteger num;

    if (num.signum() == 0) { this.num = BigInteger.ZERO; this.den = BigInteger.ONE; }
    else {

      if (d.signum() < 0) { n = n.negate(); d = d.negate(); }
      BigInteger g = n.abs().gcd(d);
      if (!g.equals(BigInteger.ONE)) { n = n.divide(g); d = d.divide(g); }
      this.num = n; this.den = d;
    }
  }
  static Fraction of(BigInteger n) { return new Fraction(n, BigInteger.ONE); }
  static Fraction of(long n) { return of(BigInteger.valueOf(n)); }

}

private static List<Constraint> eliminateVar(List<Constraint> cons, String x, NodeCounter nc) {
  List<Constraint> without = new ArrayList<>(); List<Constraint> pos = new ArrayList<>(); List<Constraint> neg = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Constraint c : cons) {
    Fraction cx = c.coeff(x);
    if (cx == null || cx.isZero()) without.add(c);
    else if (cx.isPositive()) pos.add(c);
    else neg.add(c);

  if (!nc.decrement()) return null;
  if ((long)pos.size() * (long)neg.size() + without.size() > MAX_CONSTRAINTS) return null;
  List<Constraint> derived = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Constraint p : pos) {
    Fraction a = p.coeff(x);
    for (Constraint n : neg) {
      Fraction c = n.coeff(x);
      Constraint pScaled = p.scale(c.negate());
      Constraint nScaled = n.scale(a);
      Constraint d = pScaled.add(nScaled);
      if (d.isFalse()) return List.of(Constraint.FALSE);
      if (!d.isTrue()) derived.add(d);
    }
  }
  List<Constraint> result = new ArrayList<>(without);
  result.addAll(derived);
  return normalize(result);
}

    if (!p.isFeasible()) continue;
    Map<String, Interval> iv = p.intervalPropagation();

      if (i.isBottom()) i = Interval.TOP;
      Interval old = hull.get(e.getKey());

    if (i.low != null) cons.add(ge(e.getKey(), i.low));
    if (i.high != null) cons.add(le(e.getKey(), i.high));
  }
  return State.of(List.of(Poly.of(cons)));
}

```
static LinearForm fromRVal(RVal v) {
  BigInteger c = evalConst(v);
  if (c != null) return of(new TreeMap<>(), Fraction.of(c));
  switch (v) {
    case RVal.IntConst ic -> { return of(new TreeMap<>(), Fraction.of(ic.v())); }
    case LVal.Local l -> { Map<String,Fraction> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put(localName(l), Fraction.ONE); return of(m, Fraction.ZERO); }
    case LVal.StaticField sf -> { BigInteger k = knownStatic(sf); if (k != null) return of(new TreeMap<>(), Fraction.of(k)); Map<String,Fraction> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put(staticName(sf), Fraction.ONE); return of(m, Fraction.ZERO); }
    case RVal.Binop b -> {
      BinOp op = b.op();
      if (op == BinOp.Mult) {
        BigInteger lc = evalConst(b.l());
        BigInteger rc = evalConst(b.r());
        if (lc != null) {
          if (lc.signum() == 0) return zero();
          LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
          if (rf == null) return null;
          return rf.scale(Fraction.of(lc));
        }
        if (rc != null) {
          if (rc.signum() == 0) return zero();
          LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l());
          if (lf == null) return null;
          return lf.scale(Fraction.of(rc));
        }
        LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l());
        LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
        if (lf == null || rf == null) return null;
        if (lf.isZero() || rf.isZero()) return zero();
        if (lf.isConstant()) return rf.scale(lf.bound());
        if (rf.isConstant()) return lf.scale(rf.bound());
        return null;
      } else if (op == BinOp.Add || op == BinOp.Sub) {
        LinearForm lf = fromRVal(b.l());
        LinearForm rf = fromRVal(b.r());
        if (lf == null || rf == null) return null;
        return op == BinOp.Add ? lf.add(rf) : lf.subtract(rf);
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

```
private static BigInteger evalConst(RVal v) {
  switch (v) {
    case RVal.IntConst ic -> { return ic.v(); }
    case LVal.Local l -> { return null; }
    case LVal.StaticField sf -> { return knownStatic(sf); }
    case RVal.Binop b -> {
      BigInteger l = evalConst(b.l());
      BigInteger r = evalConst(b.r());
      if (l == null || r == null) return null;
      return switch (b.op()) {
        case Mult -> l.multiply(r);
        case Add -> l.add(r);
        case Sub -> l.subtract(r);
        case Lt -> l.compareTo(r) < 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Le -> l.compareTo(r) <= 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Gt -> l.compareTo(r) > 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Ge -> l.compareTo(r) >= 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Eq -> l.equals(r) ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO;
        case Ne -> l.equals(r) ? BigInteger.ZERO : BigInteger.ONE;
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

private static Tri constraintNonLinearTri(Constraint c, String x, RVal src, Evaluator ev) {
  Fraction cx = c.coeff(x);
  Interval total = Interval.ZERO;
  for (Map.Entry<String,Fraction> e : c.coeffs().entrySet()) {

  total = total.add(eInt.scale(cx));
  if (total.isBottom()) return Tri.UNKNOWN;
  Fraction bound = c.bound();
  if (c.op() == Constraint.Op.LE) {
    if (total.high != null && total.high.compareTo(bound) <= 0) return Tri.TRUE;
    if (total.low != null && total.low.compareTo(bound) > 0) return Tri.FALSE;
  } else {
    if (total.high != null && total.high.compareTo(bound) < 0) return Tri.TRUE;
    if (total.low != null && total.low.compareTo(bound) >= 0) return Tri.FALSE;
  }
  return Tri.UNKNOWN;
}
